what_changed: EXACTLY ONE field of the pre-registered bar: null_max_abs. The effect-size thresholds, the seed count and the verdict ladder are the frozen bar unchanged, and the per-seed numbers are read verbatim from the recorded artifact. The verdict is computed by the gate's OWN compute_verdict.
a_claim_WITHDRAWN: v1 of this re-grade ran derive_bar on the +0.15 margin threshold, reported it as over-conservative, and used that as evidence the correction 'runs in both directions'. WITHDRAWN: +0.15 is an EFFECT-SIZE threshold (the FRAME_EXPLAINS rung has no noise test; the significance test lives in FRAME_CONTRIBUTES), so a noise-derived bar cannot evaluate it and a clean-failure rate of 0.000 on it is the threshold working as designed. The margin bar is UNCHANGED here at 0.15.

original_verdict_PRESERVED.detail: shuffled-label arm reached |0.0674| against a ceiling of 0.05
original_verdict_PRESERVED.note: kept because a re-grade that overwrote it would be indistinguishable from having only ever run the second grading

why_only_the_null_gate_needed_changing.reading: median +0.2190 clears +0.15 and 9 of 10 seeds clear it against a bar needing 8, so the frozen effect-size criterion was satisfied on the recorded data. The null gate is ordered FIRST in compute_verdict, so it alone produced INDETERMINATE.

independence_unit.name: peak
independence_unit.measured_from: one-way ANOVA ICC of rep1 within peak over the 14,913-tile active frame (t.active == 'active'; 1,848 peaks, mean 8.07 tiles/peak)
independence_unit.why_not_used: gap G1: a design effect from the label's ICC alone implicitly sets the prediction's intra-peak correlation to 1, which OVERSTATES it and LOOSENS the bar. The bar below is derived at deff=1 instead, which is tighter.

null_arm.THE_LOAD_BEARING_NUMBER: a CLEAN pipeline fails the frozen 0.05 bar 90% of the time, so the original INDETERMINATE verdict carried almost no information about leakage
three_independent_mis_specifications: it bounds a MAX of 10 absolute values against a threshold set as though for a single draw
abs() makes it two-sided against a hazard (leakage) that can only push a null UPWARD
the 3,822-row test set is a few hundred independent units, not a few thousand
null_arm.replacement_bar_basis: deff=1, one-sided, max-of-10 -- the TIGHTEST available

paired_empirical_null.what_it_is: margin minus margin-null, which reduces to encoder_multi - encoder_shuffled because GC appears in both and cancels. The same encoder, same split, same seed, real labels against shuffled.
paired_empirical_null.why_paired: the seeds share peaks and splits, so pairing is the whole point. Comparing each margin against the UNPAIRED maximum of the null discards the pairing and manufactures thinness -- v1 of this artifact did exactly that and reported a misleading 1.07x.
paired_empirical_null.no_p_value_on_purpose: a sign test over these 10 would overstate independence, because the seeds share peaks. The sign pattern is reported; a p-value is not.

verdict_detail: median active-frame margin +0.2190 >= 0.15 and 9/10 seeds clear it
framing_recommendation: DECLARE TWO CRITERIA -- detection and strength -- and score future bacterial arms on both. A single pooled number would keep averaging two tasks whose answers differ in sign.
honest_limits: The weakest seed (9) is the weakest on every reading: margin +0.1075 is the only one below the frozen +0.15, and its paired real-minus-shuffled gap is +0.0523 against a median of +0.1921. The frozen bar needs 8 of 10, so one weak seed does not decide the verdict -- but it is a real outlier and is not smoothed over.
No p-value is quoted for the paired null: the seeds share peaks, so any test treating them as independent would overstate the evidence.

The ICC is measured on the label within peaks and is NOT used for the bar. For a correlation the design effect is nearer 1 + (m-1)*rho_x*rho_y, so a label-only estimate overstates it and loosens the bar; deff=1 is used instead.
The null model behind the replacement bar is asymptotic (Spearman under H0 as N(0, 1/(n-1))). An exact permutation null on the real peak grouping would be stronger.
This re-grades the FRAME question only. The 0.941 pooled ceiling remains an average over deciles running 0.5013 to 0.9823, and nothing here touches the finetune arm.
Adopting this verdict in place of the original is a USER decision. Both are recorded and the original artifact is untouched.
